description: This Java class implements a command strategy for adjusting transactions on savings accounts within a batch processing system. It processes HTTP request data, extracts URL parameters, interacts with a savings account transactions API resource to perform the adjustment, and constructs a batch response.

classes.name: SavingsAccountAdjustTransactionCommandStrategy
classes.description: A command strategy for adjusting a savings account transaction within a batch processing context. It retrieves URL parameters, invokes the savings account transaction API, and returns a batch response.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the transaction adjustment command by parsing URL parameters, calling the API resource to perform adjustment, and returning the batch response.
